nodes.name: Abfrage aller Sensordaten aus der Tabelle sensor_data

parameters.query:
SELECT
  '{{ $json.sensor_id }}' AS sensor_id,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM sensor_last_empty
    WHERE sensor_id = '{{ $json.sensor_id }}'
  ), 0) AS pickup_count;

INSERT INTO sensor_avg_fill_rate (
    sensor_id,
    avg_fill_rate_per_hour,
    last_fill_level,
    estimated_hours_to_full,
    estimated_full_time,
    empty_count
) VALUES (
    '{{ $json.sensor_id }}',
    {{ $json.avg_fill_rate_per_hour }},
    {{ $json.last_fill_level }},
    {{ $json.estimated_hours_to_full }},
    '{{ $('Berechnung estimated_full_time').item.json.estimated_full_time }}',
    {{ $json.empty_count }}
)
ON CONFLICT (sensor_id) DO UPDATE
SET
    avg_fill_rate_per_hour = EXCLUDED.avg_fill_rate_per_hour,
    last_fill_level = EXCLUDED.last_fill_level,
    estimated_hours_to_full = EXCLUDED.estimated_hours_to_full,
    estimated_full_time = EXCLUDED.estimated_full_time,
    empty_count = EXCLUDED.empty_count,
    changed_at = NOW();

parameters.subject: =Smart-Trash: New Sensor
parameters.message: Es wurde ein neuer Sensor mit folgenden Parametern gefunden und neu angelegt.

parameters.query:
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.sensor_id)
        s.sensor_id,
        s.lat,
        s.lon,
        l.fill_level,
        l.created_at
    FROM sensor_data s
    JOIN sensor_fill_level l ON s.sensor_id = l.sensor_id
    ORDER BY s.sensor_id, l.created_at DESC
) AS latest
WHERE latest.fill_level >= 45;

parameters.content:
## Reihenfolge zur Entleerung
1. Sensoren fill_level > x% abfragen
2. Vorbereitung API Abfrage, betroffenen Tonnen in Format bringen
3. Abfrage der API - Reihenfolge (Optimization)
4. API Output in JSON
Abzweig 1: 
	1. abfrage der sensor_id für die lat und lon aus der Reihenfolge der API
	2. Array aus sensor_ids (in der richtigen Reihenfolge)
Abzweig 2:  	1. Array der Koordinaten als Vorbereitung für Routenberechung
	2. API1: Route als JSON, API2: Route als Geiojson (inkl. Umwandlung in detaillierte Koordinaten für die Route)
5. Merge alles zusammen
6. Variablen für DB vorbereiten
7. Route in DB speichern

SELECT
  location AS "Campus",
  type AS "Müllart",
  SUM(d.new_fill_in) AS "Summe"
FROM sensor_data_uni s
JOIN sensor_fill_level d
  ON s.sensor_id = d.sensor_id
GROUP BY location, type
ORDER BY location, type;

SELECT sensor_id, ts, new_fill_in, simulation number
FROM sensor_daily_delta
WHERE ts::date = CURRENT_DATE 
--  AND simulation_number = 2;

SELECT 
  '{{ $json.sensor_id }}' AS sensor_id,
  COALESCE(s.fill_level, 0) AS fill_level,
  s.created_at
FROM (
  SELECT 1
) AS dummy
LEFT JOIN sensor_fill_level s
  ON s.sensor_id = '{{ $json.sensor_id }}'
 AND s.created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE - 1
LIMIT 1;

SELECT fill_level, created_at, sensor_id
  FROM sensor_fill_level
  WHERE sensor_id = '{{ $json.sensor_id }}' AND created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE - 1
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  location AS "Gebäude",
  stationsname AS "Station",
  type AS "Müllart",
  SUM(d.new_fill_in) AS "Summe"
FROM sensor_data_krankenhaus s
JOIN sensor_fill_level d
  ON s.sensor_id = d.sensor_id
GROUP BY location, stationsname, type
ORDER BY location, stationsname, type;
